title: ProtocolLab Package Producer Boundary Verification
verification_method: Focused template tests, negative helper validation tests, package generation dry-runs, touched SpecTrace JSON parse/link checks, attempted full SpecTrace validation, and diff hygiene.
scope: Verify the quic-dotnet ProtocolLab package producer boundary only. This artifact does not verify live rack-lab performance, publishable benchmark provenance, broad raw QUIC support, or HTTP/3/QPACK protocol correctness.
procedure: Run the H3 package producer with `-PackageTarget Http3`, a fixed package version, and `-RuntimeIdentifier linux-x64` when a sibling ProtocolLab checkout with the package builder is available.
Run the raw package producer with `-PackageTarget RawQuic`, a fixed package version, and `-RuntimeIdentifier linux-x64` when a sibling ProtocolLab checkout with the package builder is available.
Inspect produced package JSON output, package IDs, package versions, SHA-256 values, and generated manifests.
Run a touched-artifact JSON parse and reciprocal-link check for `SPEC-QUIC-INT`, `ARC-QUIC-INT-0028`, `WI-QUIC-INT-0028`, and `VER-QUIC-INT-0028`.

Run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Validate-SpecTraceJson.ps1 -RepoRoot . -Profiles core`; if the repository baseline has unrelated validation debt, preserve the failure shape separately from the package-producer evidence.
expected_result: The focused tests pass, H3 package generation produces `quic-dotnet-dev` with HTTP/3-only declarations, raw package generation produces `quic-dotnet-raw-dev` with only the two enabled raw QUIC transport scenarios, raw H3-shaped run-helper arguments fail before upload or submission, touched SpecTrace JSON parses with reciprocal links, and diff hygiene passes. Full repository SpecTrace validation should pass only when unrelated baseline validation debt is absent.
